notes: σταθεὶς … προσηύχετο: rule 88 puts the supplied *and* on the finite verb it introduces, not on the participle it follows.
The vocative article Ὁ is unrepresented because the ASV writes a bare *God* with no supplied address word — rule 89's contrast rather than its main arm.
The intensifying καί takes *even* under rule 65's English-side test; no correlative *so* stands, so rules 82 and 100 are not in question.
